title: Bound first-observer BIT corrections (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** The retained BIT word has 60 paid rank-seven ingress events whose first observers are coframed ADDs. Grant one independent ordinary correction on each touched owner at each of those clocks, for 120 correction slots. The joint source system has 1,036 coefficients, rank 148 and nullity 888. The exact quotient at each of the ten singleton marks has zero new directions at both the literal and quiet cut. Zero persists even when every protected-paid and exterior equation is waived, and free ordinary work, routing and restoration are granted. The complete stock caps remain 14/16/18 at zero/one/two separate split fees, with best directed net below −0.8858451573064097 at the fixed target.

## Task and overlap

Changed bit-helper-contract scope, recorded in TASK.json. Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Exact scientific head 016b95e5192c4d785c3e80e55b129ca2d8865f44. #7272 fixes the old propagation after changing paid payloads. #7273 grants late exterior compensation after the fixed prebirth trace. Here the 120 post-observer slots can change that propagation, and all 60 first-observer clocks are derived from exact public source in two ways. This scope leaves other clocks, new paid edges, new unmarked libraries and their composition open. #7274 changes the complex supplier and retains the BIT premise. The branch inherits the two existing #7257 commits for the navigation and historical CI replay, exactly as in #7274. This submission adds one scientific commit.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-first-observer-compensation
    python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-first-observer-compensation --check-modes --check-source-history
    python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_current_status.py

All three passed locally on CPython 3.12.14. The standalone replay passed from an empty working directory and environment. It rejects changed native input, duplicate manifest path, a forged receiver clock and a forged quotient expansion. Exact source pins, directed rational prices, regenerated receipt hash and independent audit are in [the package](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/016b95e5192c4d785c3e80e55b129ca2d8865f44/research/bit-first-observer-compensation). No physical prototype, selected cold replay, changed supplier or materialized multiplier was required for this scope.
